_label: PHASE 3 BATCH 3B — nakshatra application claims for Punarvasu through Hasta, excluding already-covered Magha and Uttara Phalguni; universal, development only
scope: Punarvasu, Pushya, Ashlesha, Purva Phalguni and Hasta.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Deities, symbols, mythology, source history, technical rulerships and excluded classical judgments remain internal trace.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Punarvasu is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The person may approach emotionally charged situations with restraint and an underlying preference for calm.
After distraction or disruption, the mind may have a recurring ability to return to what restores coherence and emotional steadiness.
Contentment may grow through recognizing what is already sufficient rather than continually increasing what is required.
Development may involve returning to a stabilizing practice or principle without simply repeating an old pattern unchanged.

compositionRequirements: APP-PUNARVASU-RESTORATIVE-RETURN requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-PUNARVASU-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Punarvasu interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: claim that a relationship or opportunity will return
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Pushya is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Calmness and restraint may help the person remain emotionally steady when consistency is required.
Learning, teaching or thoughtful guidance may carry emotional significance.
Care may be expressed through structure, duty and the steady support that allows something valuable to continue growing.
Development may involve offering dependable care without assuming responsibility for everything or everyone.

compositionRequirements: APP-PUSHYA-SUSTAINED-CARE requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-PUSHYA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Pushya interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: automatic nurturer, parent or caretaker identity
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Ashlesha is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The mind may look beneath the surface and notice emotional dynamics that are concealed, layered or difficult to separate.
The person may be especially aware of the attachments, obligations or unspoken patterns that bind people and situations together.
Insight into a complicated emotional pattern may become entanglement when the person remains inside it after recognizing what it is.
Development may involve using perceptiveness to create clarity and appropriate boundaries rather than to control an uncertain situation.

compositionRequirements: APP-ASHLESHA-PENETRATING-PERCEPTION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ASHLESHA-BINDING-PATTERNS requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ASHLESHA-INSIGHT-ENTANGLEMENT-TENSION must appear with APP-ASHLESHA-CLEAR-BOUNDARIES or another constructive admitted claim.
APP-ASHLESHA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Ashlesha interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: dishonesty, treachery, ingratitude or harmful-character verdict
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Purva Phalguni is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Warm social exchange and generosity may be natural ways of expressing emotional goodwill.
Pleasure or creative expression may provide an important release for emotional energy.
The person may feel emotionally engaged when creating or sharing something that can bring enjoyment to others.
Development may involve allowing enjoyment and creative expression to have value without requiring them to produce recognition or a particular outcome.

compositionRequirements: APP-PF-CREATIVE-RELEASE requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-PF-GENERATIVE-SHARING requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-PF-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Purva Phalguni interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Hasta is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The emotional temperament may include boldness and an animated willingness to engage with what is happening.
The mind may work well when it can grasp the practical details of a situation and shape them into something more workable.
Emotional confidence may increase when the person can apply a skill and see a tangible result from their effort.
The desire to make a situation workable may become controlling when uncertainty cannot yet be resolved through action.

compositionRequirements: APP-HASTA-PRACTICAL-SHAPING requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-HASTA-COMPETENT-ACTION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-HASTA-GRASP-CONTROL-TENSION must appear with a constructive admitted claim.
APP-HASTA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Hasta interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: cruelty, theft, intoxication or harmful-character verdict
claim that everything can be controlled
presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively without modifying earlier application-claim overlays.
Route every claim exclusively from its purposes field; no nakshatra name or claim ID may be hard-coded into planner or writer logic.
Use the universal nakshatra introduction pattern, name the nakshatra once only and introduce the pada without repeating the nakshatra name.
Never send customerExcludedLayers, source history, deity assignments or technical rulerships to the writer.
Enforce every composition requirement and prohibited extension.
Log unused admitted claims as ADMITTED_NOT_USED without warning or failure.
Production must admit zero claims from this file until individual practitioner approval changes productionEligible.
Preserve conflict-restricted and textual-assignment-review statuses in ledger and trace.
